data.comment: Intake re-run: no changes needed. The item is already past intake (stage `in_progress`) and already has a complete intake brief (problem statement, users/user stories, 5 measurable ACs, constraints) plus a completed plan decomposing it into 5 child items. Per the intake skill's Step 1 heuristic, intake is skipped for items already at or past `intake_complete`; the stage is deliberately preserved rather than auto-completed, because `auto-complete`/`finish` would regress it to `intake_complete` — mirroring the plan skill's idempotent "stage already `plan_complete` or later -> no-op skip, stage preserved" rule. Child coverage review: recommendation `proceed` (all children either terminal or already at `intake_complete`). No interview, no description rewrite, no effort/risk re-estimate.
